title: Rabbit Species
paragraphs: “…How did things end up like this?”

After looping, I did everything I could before big sister showed up. Specifically, I passed the role of trapping Father to Itsuki. I disguised my presence so that the pig wouldn’t know where I was, which led her to go to Itsuki instead and falsely accuse Father. Seeing Father screaming in pain was heartbreaking, and I almost cried.

As for the pig that followed me? Of course, I ignored and fired her. And so, a month passed with Yuki-chan and Kou by my side. Since raising them too much or too quickly could be dangerous, I spent that month just playing with the Filolials. Now, I’m watching the scene in the courtyard where big sister has appeared.
“Is something wrong?”
“There’s a huge problem!”
Big sister pointed at the situation in the courtyard and declared it firmly.
“I understand that not saving Naofumi-sama was necessary, but why are you just standing here watching?!”

Yes, right now in the courtyard… Father was pledging loyalty to some handsome rabbit demi-human with glasses, looking at him with eyes like a maiden in love. A sparkling… white-haired beauty. He looked a bit like Itsuki.
Judging by the way he fought during the waves, his weapons were dual daggers. He looked very nimble. And now, he was pointing at Itsuki with a furious expression.
“Don’t assume your sense of justice is the same as everyone else’s! I despise your arrogant charity!”
“W-What?! How am I arrogant?!”

“Did I ask for your help? I was saved by Iwatani-sama. He bought me glasses to fix my poor eyesight and healed my immobile arm so I could fight alongside him. A slave? Fine, I’m happy to fight as Iwatani-sama’s right hand!”
“He’s just making you repay him with harsh labor! Don’t be fooled!”
“Boo!”

The pig squealed at that moment! I was overwhelmed by the urge to kill her immediately, but I held back. I’ve endured so much and held back countless times to the point where I felt like I’d get an ulcer.
“And who is that?! Why is he standing proudly where I should be?!”
“I have no idea. I just passed the role of clown to Itsuki.”

Pretending not to know and watching silently as Father was caught in that trap… it was one of the most painful moments I’ve ever endured. But before I realized it, instead of big sister, that mysterious rabbit had taken her place.
“Why didn’t you do something about it?!”
“I’ve already compromised enough!”

Knowing it was a trap and framing Father was something that even I, Motoyasu, could not endure. Well, I’ve already secured Sakura-chan’s egg just as Father instructed. All that’s left is to hand it over to the monster merchant and have it reach Father. Hmm? Big sister seems to have realized something.
“C-Come to think of it… When I first met Naofumi-sama, didn’t the slave trader introduce others besides me…? Could it be… back then…?”
“At the time, his arm was bent at a weird angle, if I recall.”

I had occasionally peeked in on them, and they seemed to be getting closer bit by bit. Eventually, I noticed that his arm had started moving properly. Well, Father had been helping him move his arm as part of rehabilitation. And he also bought him glasses.

As expected, another slave has come to adore Father. Big sister looked like she was about to collapse. As for Father, the rabbit demi-human slave held him close, just like big sister did before, and spoke words of devotion that brought him to tears.
Ah… Father. Please forgive me for enduring this agony just to save you in the original world.
“With this, I can meet Filo-tan!”
“…I doubt it’ll go smoothly.”
“The end result is all that matters.”
I was brimming with excitement. In just a few days, I would finally meet Filo-tan.
“Haa… it can’t be helped. Let’s just watch for now.”
Trash and the pig were spitting venom at Father.

Hmph… Once I meet Filo-tan, I’ll make sure to kill them immediately. While keeping an eye on Father, I provided some small assistance. After receiving 500 silver coins as severance money, he went to the monster merchant’s tent to re-register the slave crest and seemed to be playing the egg lottery. I took the utmost care not to be found. Of course, I had already arranged for the monster merchant to secretly hand Sakura-chan’s egg over to Father.
“I wonder how this will turn out… I hope it works. If I could use the power of the gods, I could even see the future…”

Big sister murmured that, but I ignored her. Eventually, Father headed to Lute Village and started helping with the reconstruction work. He even dismantled the chimera and absorbed it into his shield.
“That brings back memories. I remember doing things like that,” Big Sister muttered nostalgically.

She stretched her hand out as if reaching for something distant, but then held herself back. It seems that’s what Father was doing after the wave ended. In the meantime, he stayed in the village with the rabbit demi-human. The next day, he began hunting nearby to prepare for the next wave. Sakura-chan was sitting on his head. Ah, this time Father seems to have taken up a side job in chiropractic work.

Did he perhaps acquire some sort of shield with that kind of skill? Of course, he was also making medicine and earning money. By the following day, Sakura-chan had grown significantly… and had taken on the exact same coloration as the first time I met Filo-tan.
Could it be that Sakura-chan is really Filo-tan?
“I had a bad feeling about this, but it looks like Filo will be born safely. There were some problems and damage, but it seems that the Spear Hero’s lingering regrets can be resolved.”
Big sister muttered that while sitting on my shoulder.

Haha! My heart was soaring with excitement. And so, I was watching from afar, feeling comforted by the scene. I carefully observed Father from a distance, staying just on the edge where he wouldn’t notice me gaining experience points. When Filo-tan had grown big enough to cause trouble, Father brought her to the monster merchant.
“Well… I came to see what was going on, but I’m at a loss for words. Yes.”
“Gua!”
The monster merchant was astonished at the sight of Filo-tan.
“Now, I’ll be honest. This creature hatched from the egg I bought from you. What exactly did you give me?”
It’s a Filolial egg! The monster merchant was sweating profusely and seemed to be making excuses.
“W-Well, that’s strange. I’m certain that the lottery we offered had the egg content verified by a trusted source as a Filolial.”
Ah, of course, he can’t mention me.
“For now, we’ll call in an expert to examine it, so may we hold onto it temporarily? Yes.”
“Fine, but don’t you dare mess this up or kill her while you’re at it.”
“Gua!?”
“We understand. However, it will take a little time for the expert to arrive. Yes.”
“…Well, fine. I’ll leave it to you. But if anything happens, I’ll be demanding compensation.”
“Queee!?”
That’s what they were discussing. To think they would even consider cutting Filo-tan open! I won’t allow such a thing!
“Alright, I’ll be back tomorrow. Make sure you have an answer by then.”
With that, Father left Filo-tan with the monster merchant and walked away. I immediately went to visit the monster merchant.
“Ah, Spear Hero-sama! Yes!”
“How is it going?”
“I had many questions, yes!”
“It’s about Filo-tan, isn’t it?”
“Yes. I wanted to ask, this is…”
“It’s going exactly as planned. Filolials grow this way.”
“Queeeeeee!”
Filo-tan was thrashing around inside the cage. Ah, Filo-tan! I’ve missed you so much.
“This is strange… I met Filo, so why do I still feel so unfulfilled?” Big sister murmured softly.
“Maybe… tonight, Filo will take on her human form. When that happens, make sure to properly witness it and talk to her. That might be the key.”
“Yes! I’ll be back again. Take care of—Naofumi-sama while you’re at it. If anything happens, just call Naofumi-sama. I’ll explain the details later.”
“Uh… okay…”

As long as I can meet Filo-tan and talk to her, I’m satisfied. With that in mind, I followed big sister’s advice and killed time until nightfall. Eventually, the monster merchant, who was at his wits’ end with Filo-tan’s rampage, called Father. Ah, I’ve already arranged to cover all of the monster merchant’s expenses and payments. Everything is for Filo-tan. The monster merchant explained to Father everything I had told him. Since big sister had said to hide the fact that a hero was raising her, he left that part out.
“And what’s it called?”
“It’s called a Filolial King or Queen.”
“Filo is female, so a Queen then.”
“Y-Yes… However, since she’s grown so attached to you, Hero-sama, it would be difficult to sell her in this condition.”

No problem! I’ll buy her at any price. Hmm? Come to think of it, wouldn’t it be easier to just buy her directly from Father at this stage? That way, I could finally become Filo-tan’s master. At that moment, Filo-tan began transforming into her angelic form behind Father and the others.
“…sama.”
“Hm? Did anyone else hear that unfamiliar voice just now?”
“Well, I feel like I heard something too…”
“U-Um…”

The rabbit demi-human was pointing at Filo-tan. Haha, I can finally meet Filo-tan! As I walked closer, I was left speechless. Standing there was a glamorous, blonde, blue-eyed girl who looked like an adult version of Filo-tan.
“Master… Filo doesn’t want to be separated from Master…”
As I stood there stunned, Father grabbed the glamorous Filo-tan(?) by the hand and ran off. I was curious about where he was going, but that wasn’t the important part!
“W-What is going on here!?”
“Ah, Spear Hero-sama!?”
The rabbit demi-human spotted me and called out, but I was looking toward big sister.
“That was a glamorous Filolial who looked like Filo-tan! This is strange… Could it be that Filo-tan and Sakura-chan are separate individuals after all?”
It felt like I had seen a similar girl in a previous loop.
“You said it’s the environment! It looks like that’s Filo in this loop.”
“No, no! That’s not Filo-tan! She smells similar but is a completely different person!”
Indeed, Father had named her Filo-tan, but she was completely different. Something felt slightly off with Sakura-chan as well.
“The Spear’s regrets still aren’t resolved… This is a failure.”
“What!? Then what was the point of this past month!?”
“Meaningless!”
“W-What are you two talking about!? I’d like an explanation from Iwatani-sama.”
“My apologies.”
Big sister hopped off my shoulder and bowed.
“A-A talking monster!?”

“…It seems that you were the one in the cage next to mine. Thank you for supporting Naofumi-sama in this world. Thinking that this future might have been possible leaves me with complicated feelings.”
“Huh?”
“Well then, if you’ll excuse us. Let’s go, Spear Hero.”
“That’s not Filo-tan!”
“That conversation is over! This time, do exactly as you’re told.”

Big sister cast a spell and struck my spear. The loop icon appeared in my vision, the spear vibrated, and another loop began. The main takeaway from this time… is that Sakura-chan really isn’t Filo-tan.
But it can’t be helped. I’ll just go along with big sister’s plan until she’s satisfied.
As I was thinking that, big sister glanced at the stiffened rabbit demi-human with a complicated expression.
